+def _is_any_callable_property(func: Any, check_fn: Callable[[Any], bool]) -> bool:
+    current = func
+    while True:
+        if inspect.isroutine(current):
+            if check_fn(current):
+                return True
+        elif not inspect.isclass(current):
+            dunder_call = getattr(current, "__call__", None)
+            if check_fn(dunder_call):
+                return True
+
+        unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(current)
+        if unwrapped is not current:
+            current = unwrapped
+            continue
+
+        if isinstance(current, partial):
+            current = current.func
+            continue
+
+        break
+    return False
+
+
+def is_async_callable(func: Any) -> bool:
+    return _is_any_callable_property(func, iscoroutinefunction)
+
+
+def is_gen_callable(func: Any) -> bool:
+    return _is_any_callable_property(func, inspect.isgeneratorfunction)
+
+
+def is_async_gen_callable(func: Any) -> bool:
+    return _is_any_callable_property(func, inspect.isasyncgenfunction)
+
+

diff --git a/scripts/prepare_release.py b/scripts/prepare_release.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..820e7821e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scripts/prepare_release.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+\"\"\"Prepare a new release by updating the version in fastapi/__init__.py and adding a new version header to the release notes.\"\"\"
+
+import sys
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        print("Usage: python scripts/prepare_release.py <version>")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+    version = sys.argv[1]
+    
+    # Update fastapi/__init__.py
+    init_file = Path("fastapi/__init__.py")
+    content = init_file.read_text()
+    # Use a more specific regex to avoid replacing other things
+    new_content = re.sub(r'^__version__ = ".*"$', f'__version__ = "{version}"', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)
+    if content == new_content:
+        print("Warning: __version__ not found or already set to the same version in fastapi/__init__.py")
+    else:
+        init_file.write_text(new_content)
+        print(f"Updated fastapi/__init__.py to version {version}")
+
+    # Update docs/en/docs/release-notes.md
+    release_notes_file = Path("docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+    content = release_notes_file.read_text()
+    
+    if "## Latest Changes" in content:
+        # Replace only the first occurrence
+        new_content = content.replace("## Latest Changes", f"## Latest Changes\n\n## {version}", 1)
+        release_notes_file.write_text(new_content)
+        print(f"Updated docs/en/docs/release-notes.md with version {version}")
+    else:
+        print("Error: Could not find '## Latest Changes' in docs/en/docs/release-notes.md")
+        sys.exit(1)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
